items.title: Could Amazon Stock Survive AI Spending Outrunning Its Cash?
items.summary: Amazon now spends more on building its business than the business brings in as cash. On its July 2026 earnings call, management raised its 2026 spending plan to about $220 billion. Most of the prior $200 billion budget had been allocated toward AI and AWS. items.title: What Is Going On With Alphabet Stock?
items.summary: Alphabet (GOOGL) stock costs 22% less than the median S&P 500 company, measured by price against the past year's earnings. Alphabet's revenue still grew 20.1% over the past year, against 8.3% for the median S&P 500 company. Investors usually pay more for faster growth. So is Alphabet stock a bargain, or is the low price a warning.
